name: BN5's own NaviStats +0x3A
why: A byte of BN5's NaviStats its save holds 1, which no getter of Gregar's names: each game's own, constant through the battle.
evidence: BN5 reads it at 0x0802D42C (its NaviStats getter with r1 0x3A); in Gregar no NaviStats getter is called with r1 0x3A (searched: every call of the getters 0x080136B0-0x08013796 and the movs r1 before it)
